newsitem.title: LEBANON: Byblos Bank $50 mln Euronote sold out in 30 mins.
newsitem.headline: Byblos Bank $50 mln Euronote sold out in 30 mins.

text.p: A $50 million Euronote issued by Lebanon's Byblos Bank on Monday was three times oversubscribed and was allocated in 30 minutes, a spokesman for Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest SAL said.

The three-year bond at 285 basis points over similar U.S. treasuries set a new benchmark for Lebanese financial paper on the international market, Omar Jaroudi, senior manager for business development at Lebanon Invest said.
It compared with a trailblazing $60 million Eurobond in June by Credit Libanais bank, which was set at 325 bp over U.S. treasuries.
"This is an excellent new benchmark for future similar deals, especially as it was so much oversubscribed," Jaroudi said of the Byblos issue.
He said the issue sold like hot cakes.
"It was allocated in half an hour. It was three times oversubscribed.

"We had good interest from local financial institutions and from Japan and Europe, the (Gulf Arab) Emirates and Saudi Arabia. The main European interest was from financial institutions in Switzerland," Jaroudi added.
